resources.string: Alerts, news and app errors, all in one place
Everything the app told you over the last 30 days: it stays here even after the notification is gone from the phone. Tap one to open that share or section.

Live scan breakouts and new STRONGs, the watchlist breakouts, targets and stops, watchlist news, Big Money and Paper Trading all collect here (for the alerts that are on). If the app ever closes on an error, its report is here too.
